item.title: Black History Month Spotlight: Hannah Nokes’ Story Reveals Early Transgender Visibility in 1930s Virginia
item.description: A little-known figure from Northern Virginia history is being remembered this Black History Month for her visibility and resilience decades before transgender identity was widely recognized.Hannah Nokes, born in 1898, lived openly as a woman in Loudoun County, Virginia, well before the 1930s. item.title: Secret Service to Provide Tailored Suits to New Protective Detail Agents
item.description: New Secret Service agents assigned to protective details may soon receive a wardrobe upgrade.According to sources and a public contract solicitation, the Secret Service plans to provide two tailored suits to each agent who completes protective detail training. The suits will be navy blue, made in the United States, and include name embroidery inside the jacket.Officials say the move is intended to address cost concerns for agents early in their careers. item.description: Topo Chico mineral water is becoming harder to find across the United States, and the shortage could last for months.Coca-Cola, which owns the popular carbonated mineral water brand, says its flagship product sold in glass bottles is temporarily unavailable due to production issues tied to the water source and facilities in Mexico. item.title: Jordan Stolz leaves Milan Olympics with three medals but still wanting more after mass start finish
item.description: Jordan Stolz delivered one of the most impressive performances of the Milan Winter Olympics, capturing multiple medals and solidifying his place among the sport’s brightest young stars. But despite the success, the American speedskater is leaving Italy with a lingering sense of unfinished business.Stolz entered the mass start race already holding two gold medals and a silver, but the strategic nature of the event proved challenging. item.title: Alysa Liu’s Olympic gold inspiring young skaters at Oakland rink where her journey began
item.description: Alysa Liu’s Olympic gold medal is making waves far beyond the podium — especially at the Oakland ice rink where her skating journey began.Liu, who was raised in Richmond and trained at Oakland Ice, captured gold in the women’s singles event, becoming the first American woman to win Olympic gold in figure skating since 2002.
